questions.question: Where do adjectives go in English?
options: At the end of the sentence
questions.explanation: In English, adjectives come BEFORE the noun: "a red apple" (not "an apple red").

questions.question: What is the comparing form of "tall"?
questions.explanation: To compare two things, we add -er: tall becomes taller.

questions.question: Fill in: "Ice cream is ___." (temperature)
questions.explanation: Ice cream is cold. This is a describing word (adjective).

questions.question: Which sentence uses an adjective correctly?
questions.explanation: In English, the adjective comes beføre the noun: "a big dog".

questions.question: Vel rett: "Winter is ___ than summer."
questions.explanation: When comparing two things, add -er. Winter is colder than summer.
